methodology: Researched on 2026-09-07 using public official employer careers pages and employer-controlled ATS pages. No LinkedIn account access, employee-departure inference or third-party salary estimates were used.

Open means the retrieved employer page contains the role description and an application link/button without an observed closure notice or elapsed closing date. This is page-level evidence, not a completed ATS submission or recruiter confirmation.

Indexed_only means employer content was available through the search index but direct page content could not be verified. These leads require a fresh application-page check before being treated as active.
Rows are distinct employer requisitions, not a claimed number of headcount vacancies. Similar Pega requisitions are retained with separate IDs and a duplicate-application caution.
Locations normalize Bangalore to Bengaluru. Multi-location roles list both cities; Pune, Hyderabad and the Chennai extra are not represented as Bengaluru opportunities.

Fit is an analyst assessment against approximately four years of Pega work, CSA/CSSA, MBRDI auto-finance experience, Kafka/REST/SOAP/SQL and production automation. It is not a recruiter decision, salary forecast or success probability.

Experience_min uses the stated overall or bachelor's-route threshold where alternatives exist; master's/Pega-specific exceptions and contradictory requirements are explained in gaps. Null means no explicit figure found.

Only explicit employer posting dates were recorded. Search crawl dates and relative ages are not assumed to be original publication dates. Virtusa's explicit employer listing date is retained with the relative-date inconsistency noted.
All evidence excerpts are concise paraphrases. No applications were submitted and no recruiter or employee was contacted.
limitations: No selected role publishes a numerical India salary range; salary is null throughout. None establishes that the desired 24–27 lakh package will be offered.
Public pages and search indexes can be cached or lag hiring changes; Apply buttons are not proof that a recruiter is still screening. Verify ATS acceptance and req ownership before investing heavily.
First Citizens 24726 and Citi 26985252 are indexed-only leads; other records have readable employer pages and visible application controls.
Some employer descriptions contain inconsistent experience bands or generic accountabilities; these are flagged rather than silently resolved.
Four senior/lead-scope roles are explicitly stretch entries. They should not displace better-fitting developer opportunities in the weekly application pipeline.

Excluded obvious closed/expired or much more senior roles, including Wells Fargo R-565488 whose indexed closing date was 2026-08-30, Standard Chartered 55895 whose closing date was 2026-07-03, and multiple Virtusa postings carrying closure notices.
Search is selective and time-bounded, not a complete census. No verified suitable opening was found for every employer from the saved dossiers.
